objective: Screen OpenFOAM's documented default relaxation (p 0.3 / U 0.7) against the inherited shipped setting (p 0.5 / U 0.5) on two further case classes, paired on the same case so the answer is checked as well as the cost, and rule on whether the default becomes the family's starting point for NEW steady cases. Existing published cases are explicitly out of scope.
rationale: The F6b relaxation-invariance check (pre-registered ce0b14be, results ef3e4872) pre-registered that alternative relaxations would need AT LEAST as many iterations as the incumbent. That prediction was FALSIFIED and it is the most useful thing the check produced: the solver's own documented default converged the identical case to the identical answer (7.6480 against 7.6472, 0.0105%) in 3,936 iterations against 5,997, and 4.22 core-min against 6.79 -- a 37.8% saving, with per-iteration cost also slightly lower (0.0643 s against 0.06797 s), so the saving is fewer iterations and not cheaper ones. Nobody chose 0.5/0.5: it is the shipped ERCOFTAC PH_Breuer value, inherited unchanged on every clone, and this was the first time it had been compared against anything. Measured reach: a census of all 317 fvSolution files carrying a relaxationFactors block finds 122 (38.5%) at the inherited 0.5/0.5 and 5 at the default, 3 of which are the arms this check created today; the 122 span the Cases and DAFoam families. THE SAVING IS n=1 AND IS LABELLED AS ONE -- one 15,600-cell periodic hill says nothing certain about a 2,000-cell duct or an external body, and the same ladder holds a counter-example, a uniformly tighter arm costing 2.97x the default's iterations on that same case. This proposal buys the second and third data points, not the rollout. Pricing the it also surfaced a separate finding routed to DAFoam: all 84 f6d_random_matrix_uq ensemble members carry residualControl p 1e-15 -- the exact unreachable-target defect F6b diagnosed and closed FOR ITSELF on 2026-08-05 and never propagated -- so 0 of 84 print a convergence sentence and that zero is a false negative rather than a convergence fact, while 76 of 84 show a momentum residual rising over the run's second half.

LESSONS.md L-47 (relaxation is a path parameter, so a paired screen checks cost AND answer at once)
cost_basis: measured per case, no rate borrowed from another solver family. Arm 1 is ALREADY SPENT and costs 0: the F6b periodic hill pair is done (5,997 vs 3,936 iterations). Arm 2, an f6d_random_matrix_uq ensemble member, is priced from its OWN log -- 4,000 iterations in 135.32 s = 0.03383 s/iteration = 2.26 core-min per solve; one paired pair at a 12,000 cap prices at 2 x 6.8 = 13.5 core-min worst case, ~5 core-min expected. Arm 3, a W2_sparta CBFS case, has NO usable log in the tree -- ITS COST IS UNMEASURED AND IS RECORDED AS A GAP, NOT ESTIMATED: a 200-iteration feasibility probe (~0.5 core-min on the f6d rate as a stand-in) must measure it before the arm is committed. The 26 core-min is arm 2 at its worst case, arm 3 bounded by assuming it is no worse than arm 2, plus 1 for analysis. If arm 3's probe returns a materially larger per-iteration cost, the arm returns for re-pricing rather than overrunning.
expected_knowledge_gain: Either the 37.8% transfers, in which case every NEW steady case in two families starts a third cheaper and the lab has a measured default instead of an inherited one; or it does not, in which case the general claim dies cleanly and the finding reduces to 'the default suits the periodic hill' -- one sentence in the F6b record and nothing more. Both outcomes are worth the price, and the falsifier is pre-stated: IF THE DEFAULT NEEDS MORE ITERATIONS THAN THE INHERITED SETTING ON EITHER NEW CASE CLASS, THE GENERAL CLAIM IS DEAD. Because the screen is paired on the same case, every arm is simultaneously an L-47 relaxation-invariance check, so a disagreement in the ANSWER is a free non-convergence proof on a case that has never had one -- which is how this proposal pays even when the cost result is negative.
scope_exclusions: The four F6b_runs rungs (coarse/medium/fine/veryfine) are OUT OF SCOPE and must not be re-run at a different setting: they are the published Gate V / Gate P / Gate Q record, and re-basing them onto a number produced after them destroys the comparison this proposal rests on.
No mass edit of the 122 inherited cases is proposed or implied. The ruling sought is about the starting point for NEW cases only.
The f6d p 1e-15 finding is routed to the DAFoam family as its owner and is NOT part of this proposal's spend.
